summary: padding is space inside the border, border is the outline, and margin is space outside it. box-sizing decides whether width includes the padding and border.
notes: padding: 16px; with one value sets all four sides. margin-bottom sets only one side.
With the default box-sizing: content-box, the first demo box is 300 + 20 + 20 + 4 + 4 = 348px wide.
box-sizing: border-box keeps the box at the width you wrote. Many sites set it on every element for that reason.
pitfall: Setting width: 100% and then adding padding. With content-box the element becomes wider than its parent and causes a sideways scroll bar.
